svg.title: P004 · Customer emails that cannot be delivered
svg.desc: One row per customer with an email issue. Asha has no address, Ben's contains a space and Cia's fails the requested pattern. Dev gets NULL in the issue column. Only IDs 1, 2 and 3 remain. The final query orders the flagged customers by ID.
svg.text: Customer emails that cannot be delivered
One row per customer with an email issue.
What happens to a valid address when the CASE checks find no issue?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
Which issue does each address trigger?
Asha has no address, Ben's contains a space and Cia's fails the requested pattern. Dev gets NULL in the issue
CASE … IS NULL … LIKE '% %' … NOT LIKE '%_@_%._%' … END
Only IDs 1, 2 and 3 remain. The final query orders the flagged customers by ID.
WHERE Email IS NULL OR LENGTH(Email) = 0 OR Email LIKE '% %' OR Email NOT LIKE '%_@_%._%'
